title: Final Heat Value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the final numerical answer for the total heat absorbed as 2 × 10⁵ J or 200000 J.

title: First Law Application
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the first law of thermodynamics (ΔU = Q - W) to the overall process A→C.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly identify that the net change in internal energy (ΔU) for the cyclic process A→B→C is zero.

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The response must calculate the work done by the gas, recognizing it is only non-zero for the isobaric process A→B.

title: Process Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly interpret the p-(1/V) diagram to identify process A→B as isobaric and process B→C as isochoric.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the response uses an incorrect sign convention for work (e.g., Q = ΔU - W) or misidentifies heat as released.

title: Units and Notation
description: Optional Criteria: The response includes proper units (Joules) and clear scientific notation for the final answer.
